006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IArrayItem;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
011
012import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
013
014/**
015 * Declares the expected type information for an {@link IArrayItem}.
016 */
017@FunctionalInterface
018public interface IArrayTest extends IItemType {
019  @SuppressWarnings({ "rawtypes" })
020  @Override
021  default Class<? extends IArrayItem> getItemClass() {
022    return IArrayItem.class;
023  }
024
025  /**
026   * Get the sequence test to use to check the array's contents.
027   *
028   * @return the sequence type
029   */
030  @NonNull
031  ISequenceType getValueType();
032
033  @Override
034  default boolean isInstance(IItem item) {
035    boolean retval = getItemClass().isInstance(item);
036    if (retval) {
037      // this is an array
038      IArrayItem<?> array = (IArrayItem<?>) item;
039      retval = getValueType().matches(array.contentsAsSequence());
040    }
041    return retval;
042  }
043
044  @Override
045  default String toSignature() {
046    return ObjectUtils.notNull(
047        new StringBuilder()
048            .append("array(")
049            .append(getValueType().toSignature())
050            .append(')')
051            .toString());
052  }
053}
